decisions.reason: Omitting assembled breakout pin headers does not change the ESP32 GPIO assignments or the electrical pin mapping.
The breakout pin-header assembly decision does not affect the addressable LED supply, switching, or data-level logic.
Omitting the breakout pin headers does not alter the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The referenced connectors are the ESP32 breakout headers, not the separate connectors required for panel controls and inputs.
This Requirement tracks USB-C and JST connectors, while the source decision concerns optional ESP32 breakout pin headers; none of its connector inventory attributes necessarily changes.
The decision not to assemble breakout pin headers does not necessarily change the board dimensions, connector placement, ESP32 edge placement, or other recorded mechanical-layout constraints.
Breakout pin-header assembly has no necessary effect on the monitored rails, monitor IC, or current-monitor placement.
Omitting ESP32 breakout pin headers does not change standalone USB power behavior or the LDO capacity requirement.
The breakout pin-header decision does not alter the I2C series-resistor value, placement, purpose, or population policy.
The presence or absence of assembled breakout headers does not affect power-source OR-ing behavior or diode selection.
The ESP32 breakout pin-header assembly decision is unrelated to the passive buzzer specification.
Omitting breakout pin headers does not change the switched 3.3V rail topology or transistor pair.
